intro.text: A Thaylen sailor on the Wind's Pleasure, the ship captained by her husband, Tozbek.

items.text: Ashlv worked aboard with Tozbek and a handful of other sailors, sharing the largest cabin with him and registering the ship in port. Knowing the ship's ledgers were a mess, she shrewdly had Shallan do scribing work in exchange for passage.
During an attack on the Wind's Pleasure, Tozbek was heard begging the attackers to spare Ashlv's life. What became of her is unknown.

appearance.text: A small woman with long white Thaylen eyebrows curled down to her cheeks, seen aboard in a headscarf and a bright yellow blouse and skirt.

personality.text: A quiet presence on the ship; Shallan suspects she scolded the sailors who teased her.
